questions.prompt: What are the four main compass directions (cardinal points)?

choices.feedback: Left and Right are relative directions, not compass directions.
Up and Down are vertical directions, not cardinal compass points.
There is no center compass point. The four are N, S, E, W.

hints: The four cardinal points are N, S, E, W.
Remember: North, South, East, West.
A compass rose shows these four points.
Think of a map: N on top, S at bottom, E on right, W on left.
questions.explanation: The four cardinal points are North, South, East, and West.

questions.prompt: If you face North and turn clockwise (right) by a quarter turn, which direction do you face?

choices.feedback: Turning clockwise (right) from North by a quarter turn faces East. Turn left would face West.
A half turn from North faces South. A quarter turn (right) faces East.
Turning clockwise by a quarter turn from North faces East. No turn would keep you facing North.

hints: A quarter turn = 90 degrees.
Clockwise means turning to the right.
North → East → South → West (clockwise).
So a quarter turn clockwise from North lands on East.
questions.explanation: Facing North and turning clockwise by a quarter turn (90°) faces East.

questions.prompt: Which statement describes a clockwise turn?

choices.text: Turning in the same direction as the hands of a clock

choices.feedback: Turning to the left is anti-clockwise. Clockwise means turning to the right.
A 180-degree turn is a half turn. Clockwise refers to direction, not amount.

choices.text: Turning only on a flat surface
choices.feedback: Clockwise describes direction of turning (right), not the surface.

hints: Clocks move from 12 to 1 to 2 to 3 — that is clockwise.
Clock hands move to the right.
Clockwise = turning to the right (same as clock hands).
Anti-clockwise (counter-clockwise) is the opposite (to the left).
questions.explanation: Clockwise means turning in the same direction as the hands of a clock — to the right.

questions.prompt: You are facing South. You turn clockwise through a half turn (180°). Which direction do you face?

choices.feedback: A half turn (180°) from South faces North. East would be a quarter turn.
A half turn from South faces North. West would be a quarter turn the other way.
A half turn changes your facing direction. Facing South and turning 180° faces North.

hints: A half turn = 180 degrees.
Facing South and turning clockwise 180° (half a circle).
North → East → South (quarter turn), then → West (half turn).
So facing South and turning clockwise half a turn faces North.
questions.explanation: Facing South and turning clockwise through a half turn (180°) faces North.

questions.prompt: You face North. You turn clockwise through a full turn (360°). Which direction do you face?

choices.feedback: A full turn (360°) brings you back to the starting direction. You face North, not East.
A full turn brings you back to the start. You face North, not West.
A half turn (180°) from North faces South. A full turn (360°) faces North.

hints: A full turn = 360 degrees.
Turning 360° means you complete one full circle.
You end up facing the same direction you started.
You started facing North, so you face North again.
questions.explanation: A full turn (360°) brings you back to the starting direction. You face North again.

questions.prompt: You face East. You turn anti-clockwise (left) through a quarter turn (90°). Which direction do you face?

choices.feedback: Facing East and turning anti-clockwise quarter turn (90°) faces North.
Turning anti-clockwise from East quarter turn faces North. West would be clockwise quarter turn.
Facing East and turning 180° (half turn) would face South. A quarter turn faces North.

hints: A quarter turn = 90 degrees.
Anti-clockwise means turning to the left.
Facing East, turning left (anti-clockwise) by 90° faces North.
You can remember by tracing: E → N (anti-clockwise).
questions.explanation: Facing East and turning anti-clockwise through a quarter turn (90°) faces North.

questions.prompt: You face West. You turn clockwise through a quarter turn. Which direction do you face?

choices.feedback: Facing West and turning clockwise quarter turn (90°) faces North.
Facing West and turning anti-clockwise quarter turn faces East. Clockwise turns to North.
A half turn from West faces South. A quarter turn (90°) faces North.

hints: Clockwise = turning to the right.
Facing West, turning right (clockwise) by 90°.
North → East → South → West → North (clockwise).
When facing West, the next clockwise direction is North.
questions.explanation: Facing West and turning clockwise through a quarter turn (90°) faces North.

questions.prompt: A map uses compass directions. Town A is North of Town B, and Town C is South of Town B. Where is Town C relative to Town A?

choices.feedback: Town A is North of B, and C is South of B. So C is further South than B, meaning C is South of A.
North and South are vertical directions. East is horizontal, so C is not East of A.
C is South of B and A is North of B, so C is South of A.

hints: Town A is North of Town B: A → B = North (so B is South of A).
Town C is South of Town B: C is further South than B.
Since A is North of B and C is South of B, C is South of A.
Draw a line: A (top) → B (middle) → C (bottom).
questions.explanation: Town A is North of Town B. Town C is South of Town B, so Town C is South of Town A.
